world.title: US-Iran war LIVE: US service member killed in Iraq; missiles hit Abadan as war escalates
world.summary: Two US soldiers were killed and four injured in Iranian fire in Jordan, escalating tensions in the ongoing US-Iran conflict. In response, the US military conducted airstrikes against Iran on Sunday, targeting the Revolutionary Guard to "swiftly punish" them for the casualties. Meanwhile, missiles struck Abadan, further intensifying the situation. The conflict continues to evolve with significant military actions.

world.title: Watch: Donald Trump makes dramatic Marine One arrival at Argentina vs Spain FIFA World Cup final
world.summary: United States President Donald Trump made a notable entrance at the FIFA World Cup 2026 final held at MetLife Stadium. Arriving aboard Marine One, he captured attention before the match between Argentina and Spain commenced. His dramatic arrival highlighted his presence at the high-profile event, setting the stage for the final showdown in international football.

world.title: Donald Trump and Shakira make their World Cup final predictions
world.summary: Donald Trump and Shakira have made predictions for the FIFA World Cup 2026 final between Spain and Argentina, highlighting Lionel Messi's potential to secure back-to-back titles. Trump praised Messi's skills, particularly a decisive pass he made, emphasizing the importance of teamwork in achieving success. Both celebrities expressed confidence in Messi's abilities as a key player in the upcoming match.

business.title: Gold (XAUUSD) Price Forecast: Gold Consolidates as Oil Clouds Fed Outlook
business.summary: Gold prices are consolidating as traders evaluate the impact of rising oil prices on inflation and Federal Reserve policy. The market is focusing on inflation concerns stemming from increasing crude oil costs rather than geopolitical conflicts. This situation has led traders to adjust their expectations regarding gold's potential breakout, reflecting the ongoing interplay between oil prices and inflation dynamics.

business.title: Ethanol could soon make its way to Indian kitchens
business.summary: India's petroleum ministry is creating a policy to promote ethanol as a primary cooking fuel, aiming to decrease reliance on imported liquefied petroleum gas. The government may offer subsidies to facilitate this transition and develop necessary infrastructure. With a significant surplus in ethanol production, oil companies are also exploring ethanol-based stoves and dispensing systems for households.

business.title: RBI asks banks to clear old trade and payment mismatches
business.summary: The RBI has instructed banks to address longstanding mismatches in trade and payment records amounting to thousands of crores. Banks are required to verify documents and transactions to regularize legitimate export-import cases. Resolving outdated EDPMS and IDPMS entries is expected to enhance compliance, prevent businesses from being flagged, and ensure more accurate trade data moving forward.

technology.title: First HyperOS 4 Screenshot Appears on Xiaomi 18 Series Flagship
technology.summary: A screenshot of Xiaomi's HyperOS 4 has surfaced on Weibo, showcasing a redesigned home screen for the Xiaomi 18 series flagship. Key features include a new vertical widget slider, updated system icons with enhanced shadows, and the Xiaomi Game Center icon depicted as a white controller against a gradient background. The image hints at additional functionalities yet to be revealed.

technology.title: Apple hikes Apple Music prices: Here are the new prices in India
technology.summary: Apple has increased the prices of Apple Music and select Apple One bundles in India, following a recent hike in AppleCare+ charges for Macs and iPads. This price adjustment affects multiple markets, including the US, UK, Europe, and others. The new pricing reflects Apple's ongoing strategy to adjust subscription costs across its services globally.

technology.title: Google Play Opens to Third-Party App Stores Following Court Order
technology.summary: Google Play will allow third-party app stores to be downloaded directly from its platform, starting July 22, 2026, following a court order. This change aims to enhance competition in Android app distribution. Rival stores will also be permitted to distribute apps sourced from Google Play. This marks a significant shift in how apps are accessed on Android devices.

sports.title: Argentina lose Martínez, Romero to injury in World Cup final vs. Spain
sports.summary: Argentina's World Cup final against Spain was marred by injuries to center backs Lisandro Martínez and Cristian Romero. Martínez, a Manchester United defender, indicated a thigh issue during the match, while Romero also faced injury challenges. Their absence significantly impacted Argentina's defensive lineup as they aimed for victory in the crucial tournament match.

sports.title: Watch: Donald Trump makes dramatic Marine One arrival at Argentina vs Spain FIFA World Cup final
sports.summary: United States President Donald Trump made a notable entrance at the FIFA World Cup 2026 final before the match between Argentina and Spain began. Arriving at MetLife Stadium aboard Marine One, Trump captured attention as he stepped onto the field. His arrival occurred prior to the kickoff, highlighting his presence at the high-profile sporting event.

sports.title: ENG vs IND 3rd ODI, Highlights: All-round England seals series with 27-run win
sports.summary: England secured a 27-run victory over India in the third ODI at Lord’s on July 19, 2026, clinching the series 2-1. Despite a strong performance from Rohit Sharma during the second innings, England's all-round effort proved decisive. The match showcased competitive play, with England ultimately prevailing to conclude the series on a high note.

health.title: Anaemia, alcohol major risk factors behind brain clots, finds ICMR study
health.summary: A study by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) identifies anaemia and alcohol consumption as major risk factors for cerebral venous thrombosis (CVT), differing from Western findings that emphasize hormonal and genetic factors. Common symptoms include headache, motor impairment, and seizures. Experts warn that CVT can become life-threatening if patients seek medical help too late.

health.title: Viral Cases Make Up Three in 10 OPD Visits
health.summary: Bhopal hospitals report a significant increase in viral illnesses, with approximately 30% of outpatient department (OPD) visits attributed to these cases. The rise includes higher fevers, post-viral bronchitis, and an increase in child diarrhea cases. This surge occurs as the monsoon season begins, indicating early health concerns related to viral infections before consistent rainfall has started.

health.title: You don't have to drink alcohol to damage your liver: Doctor reveals 9 unexpected factors that could be putting it at risk
health.summary: Liver health is often associated with alcohol consumption, but various lifestyle factors can also contribute to damage. Dr. Pramod Kumar D A highlights that unhealthy diets, poor sleep, unnecessary supplements, environmental toxins, and common medications can stress the liver. Damage may occur silently, with significant function loss before symptoms appear, emphasizing the importance of consistent healthy choices for liver protection.

science.title: Pit found by Quebecer confirmed to be a 390-million-years-old meteorite impact crater
science.summary: Amateur astronomer Joël Lapointe discovered a circular pit while using Google Maps to plan a road trip near Magpie, Quebec. Researchers have confirmed the pit is a 390-million-year-old meteorite impact crater. This significant finding highlights the potential for amateur discoveries in geology and astronomy, as Lapointe initially doubted the importance of his chance observation.

science.title: Scientists studied how animals survive winter and found fruit flies rebuild their biological clock into a separate seasonal mode
science.summary: Scientists have found that fruit flies adapt to winter by completely rebuilding their internal biological clocks, enabling them to enter a distinct seasonal mode. This research sheds light on how various animals survive harsh winter conditions, highlighting the role of a seasonal gene switch that locks fruit flies into this winter mode, enhancing their resilience during colder months.

science.title: FCC approves giant space mirror as astronomers warn of risks to the night sky
science.summary: The FCC has approved Reflect Orbital's Eärendil-1 satellite, which will test a giant space mirror designed to reflect sunlight back to Earth. This technology aims to create artificial sunlight but has raised concerns among astronomers regarding its potential impact on night sky visibility and safety. Critics warn that it could disrupt astronomical observations and alter natural darkness.

entertainment.title: New match official for WWE SummerSlam following 7/18 SNME
entertainment.summary: Triple H has officially announced a match between Gunther and Nick Aldis for WWE SummerSlam. The confirmation occurred during the Fanatics Fest WWE SummerSlam Kickoff show in New York. Gunther had previously confronted Triple H about Aldis at Saturday Night’s Main Event, leading to the decision to schedule this matchup for the upcoming event.

entertainment.title: July 20, 2026: Check horoscope for all sun signs
entertainment.summary: On July 20, 2026, daily horoscopes are available for all sun signs, offering predictions related to love, career, money, health, and relationships. The forecasts cover Aries through Pisces, providing insights for each zodiac sign. The article emphasizes the importance of checking these predictions to guide daily decisions and interactions. Published on July 19, 2026, at 18:47 IST.

entertainment.title: Amaal Mallik reacts to Tanishk Bagchi's Rs 8 lakh royalty for 'Saiyaara': 'Javed Akhtar sahab fought very hard for it, I get salary of Rs 75,000 to Rs 1.5 lakh after doing one song'
entertainment.summary: Amaal Mallik responded to Tanishk Bagchi's claim of receiving Rs 8 lakh in royalties for the song "Saiyaara." He acknowledged the efforts of Javed Akhtar in advocating for fair compensation in the music industry. Mallik noted that his earnings for a song typically range from Rs 75,000 to Rs 1.5 lakh, highlighting the disparities in royalty payments.
